description.zh:
域控主机名。
必须符合Windows主机命名规范。
description.en:
The domain controller hostname.
The hostname must comply with Windows hostname naming conventions.

description.zh: 备用域控主机名。
description.en: The hostname of the backup domain controller.

description.zh: 备用域控DNS地址。
description.en: The DNS address of the backup domain controller.

description.zh:
公网带宽峰值。取值范围：0~200。    
不设置该参数或者设置为0表示不开通互联网访问功能。
description.en:
The peak public bandwidth, specified in Mbit/s. The value can range from 0 to 200.
If you omit this parameter or set it to 0, internet access is disabled.

description.zh: 云企业网实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
云企业网实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

- 如果未配置CenId，或者配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。
- 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

- If you do not specify `CenId`, or the specified CEN instance belongs to your Alibaba Cloud account, you do not need to specify this parameter.

- If the specified CEN instance belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify that account's ID.

description.zh:
办公网络VPC包含的IPv4网段。系统将根据输入的IPv4网段，自动创建一个专有网络VPC。建议您使用以下网段及其子网作为IPv4网段：

- `10.0.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
- `172.16.0.0/12`（掩码有效范围为12\~24位）
- `192.168.0.0/16`（掩码有效范围为16\~24位）
description.en:
The IPv4 CIDR block for the office site's VPC. The system uses this IPv4 CIDR block to automatically create a VPC. We recommend that you use one of the following CIDR blocks or their subnets:

- `10.0.0.0/12` (The subnet mask length must be 12 to 24 bits.)

- `172.16.0.0/12` (The subnet mask length must be 12 to 24 bits.)

- `192.168.0.0/16` (The subnet mask length must be 16 to 24 bits.)

description.zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

> VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务。
description.en:
The method for connecting to cloud desktops.

> VPC connections are established using Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink, which is a free service. If you set this parameter to `VPC` or `Any`, PrivateLink is automatically enabled.

description.zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个。
description.en: An array that contains the IP address of the DNS server for the enterprise AD. You can specify only one IP address.

description.zh: 企业AD的域名。相同的域名只能注册一次。
description.en: The domain name for the enterprise AD. Each domain name must be unique.

description.zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符。
description.en: The domain administrator's password. The password cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。

> 用户名请使用sAMAccountName，不能使用userPrincipalName。
description.en:
The domain administrator's username. The username cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

> Use the sAMAccountName, not the userPrincipalName.

description.zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限。
description.en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to cloud desktop users. Default: true.

description.zh: 是否开通公网访问功能。
description.en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the `Bandwidth` parameter to manage internet access.

description.zh: 是否开启多因素认证MFA。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA).

description.zh:
办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。    
默认值：空。
description.en:
The name of the office site. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
This parameter is empty by default.

description.zh: 协议类型。
description.en: The protocol type.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS).

description.zh: AD Connector规格。
description.en: The AD Connector type.

description.zh: 企业AD子域的DNS地址。如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则认为子域DNS和父域一致。
description.en: The DNS address of the enterprise AD child domain. If you specify `SubDomainName` but not this parameter, the DNS address of the child domain is considered the same as that of the parent domain.

description.zh: 企业AD子域的域名。
description.en: The domain name of the enterprise AD child domain.

description.zh: 交换机ID列表。
description.en: The list of vSwitch IDs.

description.zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用[SendVerifyCode](~~436847~~)获取验证码。
description.en: The verification code. If the `CenId` that you specify belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must first call the [SendVerifyCode](~~436847~~) operation to obtain the verification code.

title.zh: 创建基于企业AD账号的办公网络

descriptions.zh:
创建AD办公网络时，系统将自动创建AD Connector来对接企业AD，您需要支付AD Connector的费用。更多信息，请参见[计费概述](~~188395~~)。

调用本接口创建AD办公网络后，您还需要完成AD域的相关配置。操作流程如下：

1. 在DNS服务器中完成条件转发器。
1. 在AD域服务器中完成信任关系配置，然后调用[ConfigADConnectorTrust](~~311258~~)为AD办公网络配置信任关系。
1. 调用[ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~)获取AD域的组织单元OU信息，然后调用[ConfigADConnectorUser](~~311262~~)为AD办公网络指定组织单元OU和管理员。
    
    > 创建AD办公网络时，如果传入了域管理员和密码（DomainUserName和DomainPassword），则后续只需要配置条件转发器；如果未传入域管理员和密码，则后续需要按照流程完成条件转发器、信任关系和指定OU的配置，

更多信息，请参见[创建和管理基于企业AD账号的办公网络](~~214469~~)。
descriptions.en:
When you create an AD office network, an AD Connector is automatically created to connect to your enterprise AD. You are charged for the AD Connector. For more information, see [billing overview](~~188395~~).

After creating an AD office network, you must also configure the AD domain. Follow these steps:

1. Configure a conditional forwarder on your DNS server.

2. Establish a trust relationship on your domain controller, and then call [ConfigADConnectorTrust](~~311258~~) to configure this trust for the AD office network.

3. Call [ListUserAdOrganizationUnits](~~311259~~) to list the organizational units (OUs) in your AD domain. Then, call [ConfigADConnectorUser](~~311262~~) to specify the OUs and an administrator for the AD office network.

   > If you provide domain administrator credentials (DomainUserName and DomainPassword) when you create the AD office network, you only need to configure a conditional forwarder. If you do not provide these credentials, you must configure a conditional forwarder, establish a trust relationship, and specify the organizational units (OUs).

For more information, see [Create and manage office networks for enterprise AD accounts](~~214469~~).
